drawing.fits: her tall updo, both shoes, both hands and the whole upright bass from its scroll to its spike
drawing.look: very tall, rangy, long-limbed adult build, long narrow face with soft smile lines, calm eyes, closed easy smile, deep brown skin, silver-white hair in a tall smooth rounded updo, long-sleeved cream dinner jacket buttoned closed, its narrow midnight-violet satin lapels lying flat on the chest, a small midnight-violet bow tie at a closed cream shirt collar, slim dark charcoal trousers and polished two-tone cream and dark shoes, and thick dark ink outline, with a big honey-amber wooden upright double bass as tall as she is, with a dark fingerboard, four strings and a curled scroll
drawing.extra: She is a grown woman of about sixty-five. She plays with bare fingers only and nothing else in her hands. The bass stands on the floor on its spike in front of her, on the right of the picture, its neck rising past her shoulder to the height of her head, and it stays the same size and colour.

front.description: standing square facing the viewer and playing the bass, feet apart; the hand on the right of the picture grips the bass neck at shoulder height, and the hand on the left of the picture reaches across her waist to pluck the strings

front_3q.description: standing and playing the bass, seen in a three-quarter view from the side: the chest, hips, knees, toes and nose all point toward the lower right corner of the picture, the face in three-quarter view looking that way, playing out toward a crowd on that side, feet apart
front_3q.extra: She is a grown woman of about sixty-five. She plays with bare fingers only and nothing else in her hands. The bass stands on the floor on its spike in front of her, on the right of the picture, its neck rising past her shoulder to the height of her head, and it stays the same size and colour. The bass is turned the same way: its strings and f-holes face the lower right corner of the picture, and its wooden side ribs show along its left edge.
